query: SELECT m.product_id, (p.deleted_at IS NULL) AS "live!" FROM mapping m JOIN product p ON p.org_id = m.org_id AND p.id = m.product_id WHERE m.org_id = $1 AND m.inventory = $2 AND m.binding_state = 'bound' AND m.remote_id_kind = $3 AND ((m.remote_url IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $4 AND $4 IS NOT NULL) OR (m.remote_numeric_id IS NOT DISTINCT FROM $5 AND $5 IS NOT NULL)) ORDER BY p.deleted_at NULLS FIRST LIMIT 1
